jobs.label: Magic invocation shout
jobs.name: Short battle cry
jobs.description: One brief human RAH with a small echo.
jobs.prompt: A real adult male actor gives exactly ONE short forceful RAH, one syllable on one breath, about 400 milliseconds. Natural human chest voice, no monster processing. Immediate onset and clean voiced cutoff, followed only by a faint short diffuse room echo. No repeated cries, second vowel, growl, words, singing or music.

jobs.label: Magic invocation shout
jobs.name: Chest shout
jobs.description: One low human HAH with a brief room tail.
jobs.prompt: Exactly one compact HAH from a real adult male warrior, one syllable, one steady vowel for 400 milliseconds. Powerful natural human voice, chest resonance without artificial pitch lowering. Stops decisively; faint short room reverb afterward. No second grunt, repeated syllables, monster roar, words or music.

jobs.label: Magic invocation shout
jobs.name: Rough cry
jobs.description: One clipped human RAH with restrained grit.
jobs.prompt: A real adult man shouts RAH once, a single short syllable on one breath for half a second. Slight natural vocal rasp, powerful but recognizably human. No changing vowel, follow-up grunt or long scream. Small diffuse echo dies quickly. No pitch effects, monsters, words or music.

jobs.label: Magic invocation shout
jobs.name: Open shout
jobs.description: One strong human HAH with a quick echo.
jobs.prompt: One strong short HAH, performed by a real adult male actor. Single syllable and stable open vowel, around 450 milliseconds, forceful chest voice and clean ending. Brief quiet room echo only after the voice. No repeated shout, extra syllable, growling, pitch processing, dialogue or music.
